intro: Curgle Cranklehop's newest invention is an impressive piece of machinery, and it sputters wildly when you reach its control panel. Hippogryph eggs go into it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Super Egg-O-Matic is the latest of Curgle Cranklehop's inventions. It is quite an impressive piece of machinery.
The Super Egg-O-Matic sputters wildly as you approach the control panel.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You place the hippogryph egg into the machine. A series of beeps follows along with some strange mechanical sounds.
It appears that the Eggometer has weighed, measured, and packaged your egg. Now that's speedy service!
